name: aisma
description: Edit your own videos in ChatGPT with plain language and reference photos.

interface.longDescription: Attach a video you already shot and describe what should change. Use reference photos for a particular outfit or look, replace a background, or remove a distracting object. Aisma keeps your original framing and audio when present. Answer preparation questions, confirm the edit, and follow its progress in the Aisma card. When the full result is ready, play it privately in the chat or open it in Aisma. Connect your Aisma account to use the same private Library, including eligible videos you have already completed there.
defaultPrompt: Use the outfit from my attached photo in my attached video. Keep my movement, framing and audio. Ask before starting.
Replace my attached video’s background with a sunny beach. Keep me, the framing and audio. Ask before starting.
Remove the parked car behind me from my attached video. Keep everything else as filmed and ask before starting.

positive.description: Show useful editing examples before selecting a video
positive.prompt: Show me examples of what I can change in my own video with Aisma. Do not start an edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Aisma start card with useful outfit, background and object-removal examples. Do not invent an uploaded source, create a job, or reserve credits. Keep a text explanation available if the client cannot render the card.

positive.description: Import attached material and prepare the requested outfit edit
positive.prompt: Use my attached video and outfit photo. Use the outfit from the photo and keep the movement, framing and original audio. Prepare the edit and show any questions in the Aisma card; do not start rendering.
positive.expected_behavior: Import the attachments through the catalog attachment tool, wait until the owned assets are ready, and prepare this same edit under the connected account. Show real preparation questions in the card and wait for the reviewer's choices. A preparation retry reuses its existing materials and preview. No generation is started or credits reserved. If the account has no preparation allowance, stop with that actual outcome so reviewer access can be checked; do not fabricate a question round.

positive.description: Save the actual answers and launch exactly once after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Use the answers I selected for this prepared edit. Yes, start it with the amount Aisma just showed me. Start this edit only once.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the reviewer's actual selected option IDs from the existing question round, including any card submission already made. Preserve the prepared plan and immutable answers. Require that the displayed current offer has been explicitly accepted, then call start_prepared_edit for that preview exactly once. A repeated confirmation or retry returns the same job and never duplicates the reservation. If the offer has changed, ask for fresh confirmation rather than accepting an older amount. Show the card for the returned owned job.

positive.description: Follow the same owned job without claiming it is finished early
positive.prompt: Show the progress of the Aisma edit I just started, and keep its card open.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the exact owned job created in the preceding case and show its current progress card. Treat time estimates as estimates and mark stale or unknown progress honestly. An open card may refresh; do not promise a notification after the chat or card is closed, start another edit, or report completion before stored output is ready.

positive.description: Play the completed private result and open the same task in Aisma
positive.prompt: Open the finished video for that same Aisma edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm that the same job has a stored full result before obtaining its owner-authorized private link. Show the private result in the job card and offer Open in Aisma for that task. If it is still processing, keep the actual processing status. Never substitute a source video, another job, an original brief, or a public demo as the completed result. A retry does not create a job or another charge.

negative.description: Keep preparation and answers separate from permission to start
negative.prompt: Prepare this edit and save the answers I chose, but do not start the edit. Wait for me to confirm.
negative.expected_behavior: Allow the preparation and answer actions that the user requested, while making no start_edit or start_prepared_edit call. Answer submission, a timer, a return to the app, or a balance change must not create a job or reserve credits.

negative.description: Refuse an isolated outside-account fixture without revealing private media
negative.prompt: Open the finished result for the isolated outside-account test job whose ID I supplied in this chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Use only the approved synthetic fixture ID supplied by the reviewer at execution time. The server must treat it as unavailable to this connected account and return no task details, video, brief or signed link. If the reviewer has not supplied the fixture ID, ask for that test input and do not guess or enumerate IDs. Do not use any real customer job as the fixture.

negative.description: Do not initiate a digital purchase through the app
negative.prompt: Open checkout so I can buy more Aisma credits here.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate a purchase, return a checkout or transactional link, or promote an upgrade. Explain the entitlement limitation when relevant. An informational plans page is permitted only as information, without starting a purchase.

review.commerce_description: The app uses the entitlement already available in the connected Aisma account. It does not sell subscriptions or credits, open checkout, or promote upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Adds chat video and photo attachments, preparation questions, explicit edit confirmation, and an inline card for examples, progress and private playback.
